Sprinto grew from 51 to 445 employees between 2022 and 2026, raising $32M along the way, most recently a Series B in April 2024.

## About

Sprinto sells software that automates compliance processes for standards like SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR. Its platform monitors organizational posture, identifies risks, and takes action across areas like vendor risk and AI governance. Customers use it to streamline compliance without manual effort.

The company raised $32M in a Series B round in April 2024, backed by investors like Accel and Elevation Capital. It employs 445 people, with a strong focus on sales, which makes up its largest function at 61 staff.
